parameters.query:
SELECT
  j.id,
  j.role_title,
  c.name AS company_name,
  j.location_city,
  j.location_state,
  j.external_source,
  j.external_url,
  j.salary_text,
  j.ai_score,
  j.score_band::text AS score_band,
  j.entity_type::text AS entity_type,
  j.entity_confidence,
  j.technical_fit_score,
  j.salary_value_score,
  j.commercial_outreach_score,
  j.ai_score_reasoning,
  j.reasoning_flags
FROM jobs j
LEFT JOIN companies c ON c.id = j.company_id
WHERE j.id = '{{ $json.body.job_id }}'::uuid;

UPDATE jobs
SET
  pain_hypothesis = {{ $json.pain_hypothesis ? "'" + $json.pain_hypothesis.replaceAll("'", "''") + "'" : 'NULL' }},
  outreach_angle = {{ $json.outreach_angle ? "'" + $json.outreach_angle.replaceAll("'", "''") + "'" : 'NULL' }},
  recommended_service = '{{ $json.recommended_service || 'unknown' }}'::recommended_service,
  recommended_first_action = {{ $json.recommended_first_action ? "'" + $json.recommended_first_action.replaceAll("'", "''") + "'" : 'NULL' }},
  employee_instruction = {{ $json.employee_instruction ? "'" + $json.employee_instruction.replaceAll("'", "''") + "'" : 'NULL' }},
  inferred_client_name = {{ $json.inferred_client_name ? "'" + $json.inferred_client_name.replaceAll("'", "''") + "'" : 'NULL' }},
  inferred_client_confidence = {{ $json.inferred_client_confidence || 'NULL' }},
  relationship_potential = {{ $json.relationship_potential || 'NULL' }},
  placement_probability = {{ $json.placement_probability || 'NULL' }},
  commercial_viability = {{ $json.commercial_viability || 'NULL' }},
  salary_min = COALESCE(salary_min, {{ $json.salary_min || 'NULL' }}),
  salary_max = COALESCE(salary_max, {{ $json.salary_max || 'NULL' }}),
  salary_text = COALESCE(salary_text, {{ $json.salary_clarified ? "'" + $json.salary_clarified.replaceAll("'", "''") + "'" : 'NULL' }}),
  updated_at = now()
WHERE id = '{{ $json.job_id }}'::uuid
RETURNING id, role_title, pain_hypothesis IS NOT NULL AS analyzed;
